shared_elements: schematic carved motifs on natural rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry reductive, schematic carved imagery including a face/figure rendered with simple curvilinear signs, and both include rounded disc-like or spiral elements, but this is about as generic as rock-carved iconography gets. A shows a dense narrative panel of profile boats with crew-strokes, stick-figure humans and long vertical rows of cup-like dots, while B shows isolated three-dimensional boulder carvings of a swollen head/mask with a spiral eye — no boats, no dot rows, no comparable composition or arrangement.
